prompt: What city does the band whose song spent the most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart as of August 1, 2024 originate from?
answer: The band was **Twenty One Pilots**, whose song **“Heathens”** spent 30 weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot Rock & Alternative Songs chart. The band originates from **Columbus, Ohio**.
